description:
The state of a long job: queued, running, done or failed, with its steps as progress, counts of what it did, and the code and message of what went wrong.
Call it after any tool returned a job_id, every few seconds, until the state is done or failed. A failed job is not retried by itself: tell the person what the message says.

job_id.description: The job's id, as another tool returned it.

name: get_job
title: Get a job
